'''Mangal Shobhajatra''' or '''Mangal Shovajatra''' ({{Lang-bn|মঙ্গল শোভাযাত্রা}}) is a mass procession that takes place at dawn on the first day of the [[Bengali New Year]] in Bangladesh.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.thehindu.com/features/magazine/dramatic-dawn/article3360271.ece|title=Dramatic dawn|last=Habib|first=Haroon|newspaper=The Hindu|access-date=30 November 2016}}</ref> The procession is organised by the teachers and students of the [[Faculty of Fine Arts, University of Dhaka|Faculty of Fine Arts of the University of Dhaka]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://bdnews24.com/bangladesh/2015/04/14/mangal-shobhajatra-for-removing-evil|title='Mangal Shobhajatra' for removing evil|newspaper=bdnews24.com|access-date=30 November 2016}}</ref> The festival is considered an expression of the [[Secularism in Bangladesh|secular identity]] of the Bangladeshi people and as a way to promote unity.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=http://www.huffingtonpost.fr/2016/11/30/lunesco-inscrit-la-biere-belge-au-patrimoine-culturel-immateriel-de-lhumanite/|title=La bière belge inscrite au "patrimoine culturel immatériel" de l'humanité par l'Unesco|website=Le Huffington Post|access-date=30 November 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161130201656/http://www.huffingtonpost.fr/2016/11/30/lunesco-inscrit-la-biere-belge-au-patrimoine-culturel-immateriel-de-lhumanite/|archive-date=30 November 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref> It was declared an [[intangible cultural heritage]] by UNESCO in 2016,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.unesco.org/culture/ich/en/RL/mangal-shobhajatra-on-pahela-baishakh-01091|title=UNESCO recognises Mangal Shobhajatra as cultural heritage|date=30 November 2016|website=UNESCO |access-date=30 November 2016}}</ref> categorised on the representative list as a heritage of humanity.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news|url=http://www.thedailystar.net/country/unesco-recognises-mangal-shobhajatra-cultural-heritage-1322926|title=UNESCO recognises Mangal Shobhajatra as cultural heritage|date=30 November 2016|newspaper=The Daily Star|access-date=30 November 2016}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite news|url=http://en.prothom-alo.com/entertainment/news/131041/Mangal-Shobhajatra-listed-as-UNESCO-heritage|title=UNESCO lists Mangal Shobhajatra as cultural heritage|newspaper=Prothom Alo|accessdate=28 February 2017|archive-date=1 December 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161201013259/http://en.prothom-alo.com/entertainment/news/131041/Mangal-Shobhajatra-listed-as-UNESCO-heritage}}</ref>

== Etymology ==
The Bengali phrase ''Mangal Shobhajatra'' literally means "procession for well-being".<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.nationmultimedia.com/news/aec/asean_plus/30301254|title=Mangal Shobhajatra included in Unesco cultural heritage list |newspaper=The Nation|access-date=1 December 2016}}</ref>

== History  ==
[[File:Mangal Shobhajatra in Dhaka.jpg|thumb|left|Large paper-made replica of a [[Bengal tiger]] being carried at Mangal Shobhajatra]]
The procession of the festival was first observed in 1989,<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2016/12/01/503974771/unesco-deems-belgiums-beer-culture-a-treasure-of-humanity|title=UNESCO Deems Belgium's Beer Culture A Treasure of Humanity|newspaper=NPR|access-date=4 January 2017}}</ref> when the autocratic ruler [[Hussain Muhammad Ershad]] was the president of the country. He became the president of the country through a bloodless [[1982 Bangladesh coup d'état|coup d'état]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.thedailystar.net/op-ed/the-rocky-road-democracy-1325515|title=The Rocky Road of Democracy|date=6 December 2016|newspaper=The Daily Star|access-date=4 January 2017}}</ref>

At that time, the country was under a military dictatorship and was suffering from [[Floods in Bangladesh|floods]]. A [[1990 Mass Uprising in Bangladesh|mass uprising]] took place in Dhaka during which many people, including [[Noor Hossain]], died.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.thedailystar.net/perspective/dissent-and-the-price-freedom-1312171|title=Dissent and the price of freedom|date=10 November 2016|newspaper=The Daily Star|language=en|access-date=22 January 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://en.prothom-alo.com/bangladesh/news/85565/Shaheed-Noor-Hossain-Day-observed|title=Shaheed Noor Hossain Day observed|newspaper=Prothom Alo|access-date=22 January 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171020221216/http://en.prothom-alo.com/bangladesh/news/85565/Shaheed-Noor-Hossain-Day-observed|archive-date=20 October 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref> The students of the [[University of Dhaka|Dhaka University]] Faculty of Fine Arts decided to demonstrate against the regime by arranging the Mangal Shobhajatra on [[Pohela Boishakh|Pahela Baishakh]].<ref name=":2">{{Cite news |date=1 December 2016 |title=Unesco lists Mangal Shobhajatra as cultural heritage |url=http://www.thedailystar.net/frontpage/unesco-cultural-heritage-list-adds-mangal-shobhajatra-1323331 |newspaper=[[The Daily Star (Bangladesh)|The Daily Star]] |location=Dhaka, Bangladesh |access-date=24 January 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://en.prothom-alo.com/bangladesh/news/131111/Pohela-Boishakh%E2%80%99s-rally-gets-UNESCO%E2%80%99s-recognition|title=Pohela Boishakh's rally gets UNESCO's recognition|newspaper=Prothom Alo|access-date=1 December 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170409034056/http://en.prothom-alo.com/bangladesh/news/131111/Pohela-Boishakh%E2%80%99s-rally-gets-UNESCO%E2%80%99s-recognition|archive-date=9 April 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="Business News 24 BD">{{Cite web|url=http://businessnews24bd.com/mangal-shobhajatra-gets-recognition-as-cultural-heritage/|title=Mangal Shobhajatra gets recognition as cultural heritage |website=Business News 24 BD|access-date=1 December 2016}}</ref>

== About ==
Every year, thousands of people take part in the procession that features gigantic replicas of birds, fish, animals, folk tale and other motifs. The rally symbolizes unity, peace, and the driving away of evil to allow progress of country and humanity.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":0" /> It is considered as an expression of the [[Secularism in Bangladesh|secular identity]] of the Bangali people, uniting the country irrespective of class, age, religious faith, or gender.<ref name=":3" />

== UNESCO recognition ==
In 2014 the [[Bangla Academy]] compiled a nomination file that was approved by the [[Ministry of Cultural Affairs (Bangladesh)|Ministry of Cultural Affairs of Bangladesh]] and submitted to UNESCO.<ref name=":2" /> On 30 November 2016 the Mangal Shobhajatra festival was selected as an intangible cultural heritage by the Inter-governmental Committee on Safeguarding Intangible Cultural Heritage of [[UNESCO]] at its 11th{{nbsp}}session, which was held in [[Addis Ababa, Ethiopia]].<ref name="Business News 24 BD" /><ref name=":2"/>
{{clear}}

== Celebrations in India==
In 2017, following the footsteps of Bangladesh, the festive Mangal Shobhajatra was brought out in [[West Bengal]].<ref>{{cite news |url=http://zeenews.india.com/bengali/kolkata/ist-baisakh-mongol-sobha-jatra_164719.html|script-title=bn:এই প্রথম কলকাতার রাস্তায় ১ লা বৈশাখ হবে মঙ্গল শোভাযাত্রা|date=9 April 2017|language=bn}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eibela.com/article/%E0%A6%95%E0%A6%B2%E0%A6%95%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%A4%E0%A6%BE%E0%A7%9F-%E0%A6%AA%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%B0%E0%A6%A5%E0%A6%AE%E0%A6%AC%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B0%E0%A7%87%E0%A6%B0-%E0%A6%AE%E0%A6%A4-%E0%A6%AE%E0%A6%99%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%97%E0%A6%B2-%E0%A6%B6%E0%A7%8B%E0%A6%AD%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%AF%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%A4%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%B0%E0%A6%BE|script-title=bn:কলকাতায় প্রথমবারের মত মঙ্গল শোভাযাত্রা|last=Eibela.Com|language=bn}}</ref>
